name: Workshop
description: The bench for every agent that needs you — blocked dialogs, finished sessions waiting on their next instruction, questions and results, each with the verb it needs

settings.label: Refresh interval (s)
settings.description: How often the inbox re-reads the server. Lower is snappier and costs more screen scrapes.

settings.label: Call a session idle after (s)
settings.description: How long an agent must sit at its prompt before the bench says it is waiting on you. Lower if you are watching; higher if you are not.

settings.label: Show briefings
settings.description: Include the read-only notes agents post with workshop_brief

settings.label: Group by project
settings.description: Bucket the list under project headings instead of one flat run

settings.label: Compact rows
settings.description: One line per item — hides the session and project line

settings.label: Show backlog
settings.description: List the focused project's open GitHub issues under the inbox — all of them, or one label's worth

settings.label: Backlog refresh (s)
settings.description: How often the issue list re-reads GitHub. Minutes, not seconds — a backlog changes slowly and every refresh runs gh.
